name: epashu_generate_otp
description: Sends OTP for e-Pashu Haat authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid.

name: epashu_verify_otp
description: Verifies OTP and returns session_token. Does NOT create listings. Fails if OTP expired or incorrect.

name: epashu_register_livestock
description: Registers a livestock animal with breed, age, health, and vaccination details. Each livestock_id is unique. Requires session_token. Does NOT create sale listings. Fails if duplicate animal details exist or mandatory fields are missing.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for all transactional tools.

name: epashu_create_listing
description: Creates a sale listing for a registered livestock. Transitions listing_status to 'active'. Only the owner can create listings. Supports fixed_price or negotiable pricing. Requires session_token. Livestock must be registered. Does NOT verify animal health. Fails if livestock not registered, duplicate listing exists, or price is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for all transactional tools.

livestock_id.description: Unique identifier of the registered livestock.

name: epashu_search_listings
description: Searches available livestock listings by animal type, breed, location, and price range. Returns only 'active' listings. Requires session_token. Does NOT place orders. Fails if no listings match criteria. May return large result sets.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for all transactional tools.

name: epashu_get_listing_details
description: Retrieves full details of a specific listing including animal details, health records, seller info, and verification status. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify listing. Fails if listing_id is invalid or listing is deleted.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for all transactional tools.

name: epashu_verify_livestock
description: Verifies the breed certification and health records of a listed animal. Transitions verification_status to 'verified' or 'rejected'. Requires session_token. Does NOT guarantee animal quality post-purchase. Fails if livestock_id is invalid, records are incomplete, or certification is fake.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for all transactional tools.

name: epashu_place_order
description: Places a purchase order on an active listing. Transitions order_status to 'requested'. Listing must be 'active' and verified. Requires session_token. Buyer cannot order own listing. Does NOT process payment or transfer ownership. Fails if listing is inactive, buyer is the seller, or conflicting order exists.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for all transactional tools.

name: epashu_track_order
description: Tracks order_status ('requested', 'confirmed', 'payment_done', 'transferred', 'completed', 'cancelled'). Requires session_token. Does NOT modify order. Fails if order_id is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for all transactional tools.

name: epashu_transfer_ownership
description: Records the transfer of livestock ownership from seller to buyer after successful payment. Transitions order_status to 'transferred'. Payment must be completed first. Requires session_token. Does NOT handle logistics. Fails if payment not done, order not confirmed, or ownership records conflict.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for all transactional tools.

name: epashu_update_listing
description: Updates an existing listing (price, description, status). Only the creator can modify. Requires session_token. Does NOT create new listings. Fails if listing_id is invalid, user is not owner, or listing is deleted.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for all transactional tools.

name: epashu_track_logistics
description: Tracks transport and delivery logistics for a purchased animal. Returns logistics_status ('not_started', 'arranged', 'in_transit', 'delivered'). Requires session_token. Does NOT arrange transport. Fails if order is not in 'transferred' status or logistics not initiated.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for all transactional tools.

name: epashu_cancel_order
description: Cancels an order. Only possible before 'payment_done' status. Requires session_token. Does NOT auto-refund. Fails if payment already made or ownership transferred.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for all transactional tools.

name: epashu_negotiate_price
description: Sends a counter-offer on a negotiable listing. Listing must have price_type 'negotiable'. Requires session_token. Does NOT guarantee acceptance. Fails if listing is 'fixed' price or inactive.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for all transactional tools.

name: epashu_raise_grievance
description: Raises a grievance. Categories: 'fraudulent_listing', 'payment_issue', 'delivery_issue', 'incorrect_details', 'ownership_issue'. Must check status first. Requires session_token. Fails if category invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for all transactional tools.

name: epashu_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks grievance status. Requires session_token. Fails if grievance_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for all transactional tools.
